data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fagen was a reveler or celebrant. The name is derived from the Greek word 'phagenos,' meaning 'reveler' or 'feaster'. Fagen is a strong and joyful name, perfect for a child who brings happiness and light to the world. The name Fagen carries the meaning “Reveler, Celebrant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fagen usually hope their child will grow to embody reveler, celebrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
